name: pass7-f3-rig
comment: Runs Playwright from the APP TREE, never a second install. To reproduce: `ln -s ../../../../../../../../web/frontend/node_modules node_modules` here (the link is not banked), build the tree under audit to a scratch outDir, then `node serve.mjs <port> <dist>` in the 4230-4260 band and run the rigs. :3000 is FOREIGN and is never served or killed by this lane.
